signature: SUBROUTINE ZHPSV( UPLO, N, NRHS, AP, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$. See below for further details.

On exit, the block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L from the factorization $A = U \, D \, U^H$ or $A = L \, D \, L^H$ as computed by ZHPTRF, stored as a packed triangular matrix in the same storage format as A.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D, as determined by ZHPTRF. If $\mathrm{IPIV}(k) > 0$, then rows and columns k and `IPIV(k)` were interchanged, and D(k,k) is a 1-by-1 diagonal block. If `UPLO = 'U'` and $\mathrm{IPIV}(k) = \mathrm{IPIV}(k-1) < 0$, then rows and columns k-1 and -`IPIV(k)` were interchanged and D(k-1:k,k-1:k) is a 2-by-2 diagonal block. If `UPLO = 'L'` and $\mathrm{IPIV}(k) = \mathrm{IPIV}(k+1) < 0$, then rows and columns k+1 and -`IPIV(k)` were interchanged and D(k:k+1,k:k+1) is a 2-by-2 diagonal block.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-`NRHS` right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the N-by-`NRHS` solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, D(i,i) is exactly zero.  The factorization has been completed, but the block diagonal matrix D is exactly singular, so the solution could not be computed.
